audience: retail and accounting teams with a Bsale token issued for their company

useCases.title: Review sales by branch
useCases.text: Compare sales totals by month, branch and document type, then inspect individual documents.

useCases.title: Find stock shortages
useCases.text: Look up a SKU and check its stock, reserved quantity and availability in each branch.

useCases.title: Check customer receivables
useCases.text: Find a customer and inspect unpaid documents and outstanding amounts before recording a payment.

useCases.title: Record a payment
useCases.text: Check the customer’s unpaid documents and available payment methods, then record the requested payment. This updates receivables and cannot be removed through this API.
